name: Karli
description: A desert wizard who attacks Greensleeves' camp.

description_citations.text: "Shattered Chains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The wizard Greensleeves calls a Giant Badger to her aid in a battle with the desert mage Karli.
timeline.quote: The wizard Greensleeves called a Giant Badger to her aid in an battle with the desert mage Karli.

citation.text: Giant Badger (HarperPrism Book Promos, 1995), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli lead a surprise attack on her camp; Haakon fireballs Gull.
timeline.quote: Haakon unleashed a fireball at Gull, seemingly killing him

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves is declared High Wizard of the Domains as the remaining wizards submit.
timeline.quote: She was declared the High Wizard of the Domains by her followers

citation.text: "Battle of Lat-Nam", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karli summons a Junun efreet in 4074 and 4077 AR to attack Gull's army.
timeline.quote: summoned a female Junún efreet in 4074 and 4077 AR to attack Gull 's army

citation.text: "Efreet", section "Rabiah". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Towser and Karli summon nine defeated wizards to the tropical island; Towser has stolen and copied the Nova Pentacle and reveals his Keldon warlord.
timeline.quote: Towser reveals that he has stolen Greensleeves' Nova Pentacle and copied it.

citation.text: "Final Sacrifice", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The desert wizard Karli raids the convoy and kills a third of Gull's force before being driven off.
timeline.quote: Karli killed a third of Gull's force, but was eventually driven off.

citation.text: "Gull's Crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karli summons two Hasran ogresses in 4074 AR to attack Gull's army.
timeline.quote: The desert wizard Karli summoned two Hasran ogresses in 4074 AR to attack Gull 's army.

citation.text: "Ogre", section "Rabiah". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakel is teleported to Greensleeves' camp as Karli attacks, and agrees to join their crusade.
timeline.quote: The warrior woman quickly agrees to join their "crusade".

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Greensleeves frees Dacian and Haakon, who form a truce and seek Karli to stop the crusade.
timeline.quote: Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek out Karli

citation.text: "Shattered Chains", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The army captures Dacian and puts the helmet on him; Dacian and Haakon form a truce and seek Karli and Towser.
timeline.quote: Dacian and Haakon formed a truce
